title: Glowing cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd27a' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb347' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- saucer -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#e86a3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#ffb08a'/>
  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M72 45 q18 8 0 20' stroke='#ff8c5a' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 45 q12 8 0 20' stroke='#ffb08a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cup body -->
  <path d='M28 42 L32 82 Q50 90 68 82 L72 42 Z' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <path d='M28 42 L32 82 Q50 90 68 82 L72 42 Z' fill='#ffb08a' opacity='0.35' transform='translate(-4,0)'/>

  <rect x='31' y='64' width='38' height='6' fill='#ffe08a'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='7' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#e86a3a'/>
  <!-- cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='15' ry='4' fill='#8a4b2a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='11' ry='3' fill='#c76a3a'/>
  <!-- glow on cocoa -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='6' ry='2' fill='#ffd27a' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M42 30 q-5 -8 0 -14 q5 -6 0 -12' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M50 28 q-5 -8 0 -14 q5 -6 0 -12' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M58 30 q-5 -8 0 -14 q5 -6 0 -12' stroke='#ffd27a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
